# Looseleaf

Source: https://github.com/kevintngo/looseleaf
Revision: 4bdb647940e2fefb3cebb394f3bad25c766a27d2
License: MIT (see LICENSE)

Original React components, ink engine, paper textures, theme, and Kevin Sans fonts by Kevin Ngo. Imports rewritten to relative paths. Font fallback uses local assets. Theme CSS is compiled and scoped to .ll-ui by scripts/build-looseleaf-css.mjs. Run node scripts/vendor-looseleaf.mjs to restore this pinned version.
